title: (RHEA-2025:23541) Red Hat OpenShift GitOps v1.19.0 bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary: Red Hat OpenShift GitOps v1.19.0 bug fix and enhancement update
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift GitOps v1.19.0 bug fix and enhancement update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift GitOps|Red Hat OpenShift GitOps|1.19|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
An update is now available for Red Hat OpenShift GitOps.
Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):
* GITOPS-6281 (Implement controller-runtime options to optimize Operator's object cache)
* GITOPS-6366 (FIPS enablement : Enable FIPS compliant build for Argo CD Agent)
* GITOPS-6809 (Argocd Notification Controller appears to be holding old TCP connections open to api.github.com)
* GITOPS-7000 (FIPS enablement : Enable FIPS compliant build for Argo CD Plugin Server)
* GITOPS-7315 (Host name error for ApplicationSet Webhook Server route)
* GITOPS-7329 (Different values for app.kubernetes.io/name label in Role and RoleBindings)
* GITOPS-7358 (Image Updater: Tech Preview pre-requisite items)
* GITOPS-7385 (Argo CD 3.0: Use Annotation-Based Tracking by Default)
* GITOPS-7416 (Provide option for editing resource requests and limits for gitops-plugin component)
* GITOPS-7475 (Default argocd instance does not get recreated after deletion deletion)
* GITOPS-7484 (Argo CD local user management: contribute additional ginkgo E2E tests)
* GITOPS-7491 (Image Updater: Release notes documentation for tech preview)
* GITOPS-7608 (Redis HA pods are taking longer than expected to come up)
* GITOPS-7610 (Image Updater: Integration into Red Hat productization)
* GITOPS-7631 (Argo CD Applications Details Page and Tabs in Dev Console)
* GITOPS-7678 (Remove configmap dependency for principal deployment)
* GITOPS-7680 (Argo CD ApplicationSet Details Page and Tabs in Dev Console)
* GITOPS-7692 (Principal should reject agents named like the argo-cd installation namespace)
* GITOPS-7704 (Support Argo CD Notifications in Any Namespace)
* GITOPS-7721 (Support image pull policy configurations in GitOps)
* GITOPS-7728 (Argo CD Operator: Allow exposing Argo CD Agent principal via Route, using ArgoCD CR)
* GITOPS-7729 (Argo CD Operator: Allow exposing Argo CD Agent principal via Route, using ArgoCD CR)
* GITOPS-7730 (Argo CD Agent: argocd-agent-resource-proxy service is missing in the Operator )
* GITOPS-7731 (Argo CD Agent: Argo CD Redis NetworkPolicy should allow agent to connect to it)
* GITOPS-7737 (Image Updater: Important community fixes and enhancements for TP)
* GITOPS-7740 (Agent User Documentation Architecture/concepts)
* GITOPS-7741 (Agent User Documentation: Install)
* GITOPS-7742 (Agent User Documentation: Configuration)
* GITOPS-7790 (ArgoCD agent: In argocd-operator, 'argocd-redis' is hardcoded as redis server address, when installing argo cd agent)
* GITOPS-7821 (RC 1.18.0-3: UX- Devconsole Application details page sorting issue)
* GITOPS-7836 (Argo Agent: Application is not recreated in managed mode upon deletion from spoke)
* GITOPS-7837 (Remove dependency on argocd-redis secret for principal deployed through operator)
* GITOPS-7838 (Required for Multi-cluster GitOps - GA)
* GITOPS-7844 (GitOpsService controller creates default ArgoCD with v1alpha1 api version)
* GITOPS-7924 (Agent User Documentation Architecture/concepts)
* GITOPS-8019 (CVE-2025-49844 - Vulnerability with Redis)
* GITOPS-8031 (Hide Dev Preview Badge in GitOps Operator's Operand tabs)
* GITOPS-8034 (Agent User Documentation: Install)
* GITOPS-8035 (Agent User Documentation: Configuration)
* GITOPS-8093 (Argo agent : InvalidImageName error using agent-helm-build by konflux)
* GITOPS-8094 (Argo agent: Unable to run agent in secure mode)
* GITOPS-8140 (Image Updater: git write-back to helmvalues file produces wrong structure)
* GITOPS-8142 (CVE-2024-45337 reported by RHACS for OpenShift GitOps Operator v1.18.1 (ArgoCD-based) due to outdated git-lfs binary, dependency update required to remove false positive.)
* GITOPS-8144 (Image Updater: Cannot use digest update strategy with forceUpdate: true without version constraint)
* GITOPS-8152 (ArgoCD CR Reconciliation fails if spec.applicationSet.webhookServer.route.enabled is set to true)
* GITOPS-8210 (Agent cluster roles are created for namespaced instances)
